reason: OSM Northern junction doubles back 44 m along the main straight. Its declared shared node is beyond the physical junction; this creates a false acute turn. Same-node joins are not weakened. Eastern is independently digitized from the openly licensed 2025 LINZ image. The four other named layouts retain exact original source coordinates, boundaries, timing and models.

notes: A draft short Eastern course using the mapped Northern central return, shared straight and terminal Eastern bend. The source is tagged raceway and its same-node joins are preserved. Branch names are descriptive, not homologation labels; independently measured length is 1180.2 m. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

imagery.attribution: Environment Canterbury; imagery by Aerial Surveys, captured March 2025; hosted and processed by Toitū Te Whenua LINZ, CC BY 4.0. Reprojected, cropped and sampled by OpenRacetrackDB.
imagery.note: Nearest-neighbour reprojection of native 0.075 m CC BY 4.0 imagery sampled at 0.2 m. Missing cells retain alpha; no pixels are filled. Capture interval is collection metadata, not exact tile flight date.

authoring.note: Centripetal Catmull-Rom interpolation of image-selected centerline pins; sampled vertices are fitted controls, not additional independent observations.

limitations: Draft route identification; historical alignment and direction provisional. Image interpolation is not a survey. No catalogue length was fitted. No start/finish coordinates were copied from other layouts.
